G=load(); print(sorted(G))

                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            a,b=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=a<len(grid) and 0<=b<len(grid[0]) and grid[a][b]==c and (a,b) not in seen:
                                seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
                ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
                found.append((min(ys),min(xs),[[1 if (y,x) in cells else 0 for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)] for y in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1)]))
    def syms(g):
        n=lambda m: tuple(tuple(r) for r in m)
        res=set(); x=[r[:] for r in g]
        for k in range(4):

'''
